bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
old=create-videobot:reissue-invoice-fd5f32aa47e3c8559fe252244919bd736a267119
sha=9b1075b02564b5996904659ef48dadd178f87a13
new=create-videobot:invoice-only-9b1075b0
stage=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/invoice-only-9b1075b02564b5996904659ef48dadd178f87a13
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = b69612c64c22af1540b7294625658ebffa946270 || exit 41
test -n "$(docker image inspect "$old" --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 42
git fetch origin refs/heads/feat/reissue-video-invoice-preserve-existing-buyer-20261124 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 43
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 44
mkdir -p "$stage/src/telegram" "$stage/test"
for p in src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/pgPostingReceipts.test.mjs;do
 git show "$sha:$p" > "$stage/$p" || exit 45
done
cat > "$stage/Dockerfile" <<'EOF'
FROM create-videobot:reissue-invoice-fd5f32aa47e3c8559fe252244919bd736a267119
COPY --chown=node:node src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs /opt/videobot/test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node test/pgPostingReceipts.test.mjs /opt/videobot/test/pgPostingReceipts.test.mjs
EOF
docker build --pull=false --network=none -t "$new" -f "$stage/Dockerfile" "$stage" >/dev/null || exit 46
for p in src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/pgPostingReceipts.test.mjs;do
 docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$new" "/opt/videobot/$p" | awk '{print $1}' > "$stage/$(basename "$p").$(echo "$p" | cut -d/ -f2).image.sha"
 sha256sum "$stage/$p" | awk '{print $1}' > "$stage/$(basename "$p").$(echo "$p" | cut -d/ -f2).source.sha"
 cmp -s "$stage/$(basename "$p").$(echo "$p" | cut -d/ -f2).image.sha" "$stage/$(basename "$p").$(echo "$p" | cut -d/ -f2).source.sha" || exit 47
done
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$new" --test test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/pgPostingReceipts.test.mjs test/videoInvoiceSales.test.mjs >/dev/null || exit 48
for p in src/telegram/menuPanel.mjs src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/stickerSales.mjs src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs src/sales/pgUnifiedStarsSales.mjs src/telegram/videoInvoiceSales.mjs src/sales/pgVideoInvoiceOrders.mjs owner/gateOwner.mjs;do
 a="$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$old" "/opt/videobot/$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
 b="$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$new" "/opt/videobot/$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
 test "$a" = "$b" || exit 49
done
echo VIDEO_INVOICE_ONLY_STAGED_HASH_AND_TEST_PASS
